$comment: Pages drafted or substantially rewritten with AI assistance during the 2026 modernization. The builder labels these near the lesson heading with a modest 'AI-assisted lesson' link. A Markdown page can also opt in with an <!-- ai-assisted --> comment, which is preferred for new work. This list was inferred from CHANGELOG.md and the 2026 lesson conventions (Prerequisites/Status/Time lines, Exercise/Check sections, pinned sources); it was not checked against git history. Historical lessons that only gained a 'Historical lesson' banner are deliberately excluded. Verify with git log and adjust freely.
